description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Umaro
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Avalanche Mog (0~2), removed after using Avalanche Mog two times

description.name: Avalanche Mog Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Avalanche Mog level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Umaro]

description.name: Avalanche Mog Level
description.text: Keeps track of Avalanche Mog level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Umaro]
